drinks.name: Matcha latte
drinks.notes: House recipe. Adjust sweetness and milk to taste.
preparation: Sift the matcha into a bowl.
Whisk with the measured water at the listed water temperature, then mix in honey.
Steam the oat milk to the milk target temperature. Pour over the matcha and serve.

drinks.name: London Fog
drinks.notes: House recipe. Adjust sweetness and milk to taste.
preparation: Steep Earl Grey in the measured hot water for 3 minutes, then strain.
Stir the sweetener and vanilla into the brewed tea.
Steam the milk to the target temperature and pour over the tea.

drinks.name: Cortado
drinks.notes: House proportions: 42 g espresso to 120 g milk.
preparation: Pull espresso to the listed yield.
Steam the milk to the target temperature with fine, glossy microfoam.
Pour the milk into the espresso and serve.
